_doc: CTSF Phase-3 residual-set-diff gate baseline (#186). Frozen typed-residual set of the in-code frozen_gate_corpus, keyed {sid: {family: count}} with only non-zero families retained. The gate FAILs iff a NEW replay_bug/unknown residual appears vs this set; WARNs on a typed oracle/editorial/state-index/temporal move. Regenerate with `uv run python -m lawvm.core.ctsf_gate --update-baseline` after a legitimate, reviewed change to the frozen corpus or the projection.
